title: Review: list_orders performance smell

findings.summary: list_orders performs one tenant query, then calls get_order once per row, causing N additional cache/database lookups.
get_order returns cached data before rechecking tenant_id, while cache keys contain only order_id; stale or reused IDs can expose another tenant's order.

title: Constrained fix: webhook idempotency

Perform payment persistence, OrderPaid outbox insertion, and order status update only after the claim succeeds.
Return duplicate for an already-claimed webhook; keep api/webhooks.py unchanged.
